one_line_pitch: AI console that turns a product PDF or chat-built PRD into department subprojects with estimates and pushes them to Jira with a live dashboard.

sponsor_fit_note: Targeted at Goldman Sachs with a compliance-style vendor risk workflow using human-in-the-loop approval and audit logging; also uses NVIDIA Nemotron for explanations.
impact_claims_note: States onboarding can take up to six months; no measured results from the tool.

one_line_pitch: Chat-based investing platform where beginners describe trading strategies in plain language, get them backtested on simulated data, and receive AI feedback including chart analysis.
problem_statement: Beginners and non-coders find investing and algorithmic trading overwhelming and cannot build or test strategies.
distinctive_notes: Multi-agent setup (Autogen) on SambaNova-hosted Llama models, with Llama 90B Vision reading generated performance graphs. Also entered in a separate Lightning Fast AI Hackathon where it holds the First Place badge.

sponsor_fit_note: Recommendation app framed around Frontier internet products and tenant rental experience, with mock or dataset-based recommendations.
one_line_pitch: Product recommendation app for Frontier internet customers, using a hybrid collaborative-filtering model to suggest suitable products and help with their use.
problem_statement: Customers do not know which telecom or tech product fits their need or how to use it, and documentation alone does not help.
distinctive_notes: Hybrid memory- and model-based collaborative filtering recommender modeled on Amazon-style systems, with a React/TypeScript/Tailwind frontend on Supabase. Writeup contains leftover chatbot filler text in the learned section.

sponsor_fit_note: Streamlit served as the whole UI and SambaNova-hosted Llama models did clothing classification and chat, matching both prizes.
impact_claims_note: Cites statistics on yearly clothing spend, share of clothes worn and projected fashion emissions growth; sources not shown.
one_line_pitch: Wardrobe manager that classifies clothing from photos with vision LLMs, tracks wear patterns, emails reminders about unworn items and helps list them for sale.
problem_statement: People buy lots of clothing but wear little of it, creating waste and fashion landfill.
target_user: fashion-conscious consumers wanting to reduce clothing waste
distinctive_notes: Entire UI built in Streamlit; SambaNova-hosted Llama vision and text models drive item recognition plus an agent called SambaFit; Brevo sends unworn-item emails. Repo has about 100 commits.

one_line_pitch: Swift app that analyzes a video of an office or property, detects furniture, flags wear such as rips and stains, and suggests sustainable repairs.
problem_statement: Properties replace furniture too often; prioritizing repair and maintenance would cut cost and environmental impact.
distinctive_notes: Beginner-track winner combining native Swift frontend with Google Vision labeling of extracted video frames and Llama for condition analysis; frames are stored in Pinata.

one_line_pitch: Solo-built companion web app for hackathon participants with a duck mascot, a to-do list, an interactive Google Map and a five-day weather forecast.
problem_statement: Out-of-state hackathon participants in an unfamiliar city can feel lonely and lack local context.
distinctive_notes: Built by one person by customizing the hackathon Guided Track starter project; to-do list is hard-coded and the planned GPT chat for the duck was not implemented.

one_line_pitch: Multi-agent LLM command center that links product-management tools and turns strategy and KPIs into Jira/ADO-ready stories.
problem_statement: PMs waste time on copy-paste glue across Jira, Confluence and chats, and strategy rarely flows into backlog stories.
distinctive_notes: Adapter layer gives Jira and Azure DevOps parity; agent loops capped at three to limit drift; demo uses mock analytics CSV rather than live data.
sponsor_fit_note: PNC track fit appears to be a workplace productivity tool; no PNC-specific API is named on the page.

one_line_pitch: AI dashboard for telecom teams that pairs network performance data with social sentiment to predict outages and suggest actions.
problem_statement: Network performance data and customer sentiment are analysed separately, so telecom teams spot service problems and frustration late.
target_user: Telecom product managers and network engineers
distinctive_notes: Blends Kaggle network data (plus simulated outages) with Reddit/X sentiment into a Customer Happiness Index; outage models trained offline with random forest and gradient boosting.
sponsor_fit_note: Telecom-focused sentiment and outage dashboard for the T-Mobile track; Auth0 used for login per the writeup.

one_line_pitch: Developer service that detects breaking changes when upgrading API versions, using deterministic diffing guided by an agentic LLM.
problem_statement: Migrating to a new API version means tediously testing endpoints and hunting subtle response differences by hand.
distinctive_notes: Dashboard proxies API calls to protect tokens; uploaded request logs feed tests; deterministic diff engine is paired with Nemotron agent; multi-tenant auth only groundwork, not implemented.
sponsor_fit_note: Writeup does not mention State Farm specifically; it is a developer tool using Nvidia's Nemotron model.

one_line_pitch: Onboarding platform for banks that manages clients from lead prospecting through full onboarding with role-based dashboards.
problem_statement: Financial institutions lose efficiency to manual client onboarding processes.
distinctive_notes: Multi-role system (clients, vendors, employees) with sales pipeline, client list and risk assessment screens; no AI mentioned in the writeup.
sponsor_fit_note: Banking onboarding workflow tool fitted to the Goldman Sachs track; no Goldman API named.

one_line_pitch: AI car-buying concierge that surveys shoppers, recommends Toyotas, chats or simulates phone calls, and books test drives and emails quotes.
problem_statement: Car shoppers lack confidence, time and knowledge to take the first step toward buying.
distinctive_notes: Named from Toyota plus Nemotron to target two sponsor tracks; multi-agent orchestration with tool layer for email, calendar and trade-in estimates; phone-style voice agent via Retell.
sponsor_fit_note: Built explicitly for the Toyota and Nvidia tracks: Nemotron powers agent reasoning for a Toyota shopping assistant.

one_line_pitch: Kid-oriented banking app where an NFC Spendy card authorises in-game currency purchases and parents review spending and reload funds.
problem_statement: Digital payments make money intangible, so children struggle to visualise spending and manage their own money.

sponsor_fit_note: Financial-literacy app for kids targeting the Capital One track; no Capital One API named.

one_line_pitch: Commercial real estate intelligence platform with agent-driven navigation, forecasting, property comparison, pros/cons analysis and market sentiment.
problem_statement: Most people lack knowledge and access to commercial real estate because few agents work in that segment.
target_user: Commercial real estate investors and first-time buyers
distinctive_notes: Reasoning agents adapt the dashboard layout to context; relies on web scraping; README says Llama 3.1 via Ollama/vLLM with Gemini fallback and MongoDB Atlas.
sponsor_fit_note: Commercial real estate analytics platform aimed at the CBRE challenge.
impact_claims_note: Cites a figure that only 21% of US real estate agents work with commercial properties.

one_line_pitch: Wearable Arduino badge that senses heat and humidity hazards and lets teammates exchange silent vibration/LED alerts, with a React ticket dashboard.

distinctive_notes: Breadboard prototype with DHT11 sensor, LCD, LEDs, buzzer and two Arduinos exchanging serial alerts; also an AutoCAD badge model, Figma design and React dashboard on simulated data.

impact_claims_note: Cites 1.7 billion unbanked adults worldwide as the motivating market size.

one_line_pitch: Upload files into a shareable capsule retrievable by URL, QR code or NFC card, for things like medical documents or pet tags.

sponsor_fit_note: Uses Pinata file storage with per-file metadata and signed URLs as the entire storage layer.

one_line_pitch: Personal finance app with an AI budgeting chatbot, automatic expense categorisation, savings goals and analytics dashboards.
problem_statement: Budgeting and saving feel complex and daunting for many people.

one_line_pitch: VR platform where property managers explore virtual offices, view live energy and water data, talk to an AI assistant and feel inefficiencies through haptic gloves.

one_line_pitch: Mobile banking app for individuals and small businesses with QR payments, goal-based savings, loan planning and a Gemini financial assistant.

sponsor_fit_note: Inclusive banking app for the Goldman Sachs track; no Goldman API named.

one_line_pitch: Web analytics tool letting Toyota engineers chart and compare fuel efficiency and emissions of Toyota and rival vehicles, with an AI chatbot.

one_line_pitch: AI note-taking app with real-time lecture transcription, natural-language editing, diagram generation, sharing, PDF export and a voice assistant.

one_line_pitch: Lecture companion that live-transcribes speech, captures slides via a camera hidden in a Poyo plush keychain, and compiles exportable LLM notes.

one_line_pitch: Finds a fair meeting spot for a friend group by computing an inverse-weighted midpoint of everyone's location and searching nearby places.

impact_claims_note: Cites an Eventbrite survey figure that 69% of people find coordinating plans with friends difficult.

one_line_pitch: EEG headset reads focus and relaxation and a Gemini-driven live composer turns them into adaptive Sonic Pi music, aimed at kids with developmental disabilities.

impact_claims_note: Cites 1 in 10 US children with developmental disabilities and a 15.59% projected music therapy market growth rate.

one_line_pitch: Listens to live office-hour conversation and automatically inserts the useful points into the right lines of course notes using transcription, retrieval and LLM edits.

problem_statement: People who lose their voice box after laryngectomy cannot speak in their own voice; existing devices give robotic sound.

sponsor_fit_note: Used Cartesia Sonic for streaming cloned-voice output with emotion and Cartesia Ink for caller transcription over a live phone call.
impact_claims_note: Cites ~190,000 yearly voice-box cancer cases and measured error rates, latency and accuracy figures from its own tests.

one_line_pitch: Agentverse multi-agent pipeline that turns a text prompt into a walkable 3D interior rendered in the browser.
problem_statement: Most people can describe a space they want but cannot model it in 3D.
distinctive_notes: All agents read and update one shared WorldSpec; WebSocket streams agent progress live; geometric validators; procedural assets replaced unreliable external furniture catalog links; repo name is WorldEdit.
sponsor_fit_note: Described as a staged pipeline of about 29 Agentverse agents coordinating a shared world spec.

one_line_pitch: Telemedicine tool for Mohs surgery that gives remote surgeons a 3D face reconstruction and auto-generated time-stamped transcripts from the operating room.
problem_statement: Rural patients lack access to Mohs-surgery specialists, raising delays and error risk.
target_user: remote consulting surgeons and rural dermatology patients
distinctive_notes: Uses Instant Splat for 3D face; AWS Transcribe diarization, LITA video actions, Neo4j GraphRAG into Meditron 7B; 3D reconstruction takes 45+ minutes so only initial scan shown, not live.

one_line_pitch: Web app that teaches Krav Maga self-defense moves and scores the user live via webcam pose comparison.
problem_statement: Gender-based violence is widespread and many people lack accessible self-defense instruction.
target_user: women and young people wanting self-defense training
distinctive_notes: Accuracy computed as mean squared error of angles between limb vectors from MediaPipe pose; live video via Streamlit embedded as iframe in React page; beginners on the team.
impact_claims_note: Cites 736 million women having experienced gender violence and about 26% aged 15 to 24.

one_line_pitch: Chrome extension that compresses LLM chat prompts to save tokens and summarizes conversation context for reuse in new chats.
problem_statement: Users waste token limits on poorly crafted prompts and lose context when restarting chats.
distinctive_notes: Routes plain text through spaCy stop-word/lemma trimming and code through a LangChain GPT agent; Firebase stores prompt pairs wiped at session end; button placed beside chat send button.
impact_claims_note: Claims 47% token reduction for plain text and 35% for code inputs; method not shown.

one_line_pitch: Aggregates blood tests, mammograms, slide images and scRNA-seq data through AI models and an LLM into one breast cancer report.
problem_statement: Breast cancer diagnosis needs several specialists over weeks, and access gaps hit minority and low-income patients hardest.
distinctive_notes: Multimodal inputs (four data types) fed to separate models then LLM-compiled; encrypted patient records in Postgres aiming at HIPAA compliance; page lists many LLM providers.
impact_claims_note: Says a month-long four-doctor process becomes a couple of minutes; no measurements given.

one_line_pitch: One-button Android app that remotely cuts Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular and ports on all a user's devices through MQTT endpoints.
problem_statement: Consumer cyber defense tools are costly and complicated, with no easy way to airgap many devices at once.
target_user: everyday users and travelers worried about attacks
distinctive_notes: Android controller plus Windows and Linux endpoint agents listening on HiveMQ cloud MQTT over TLS 1.2; users can bring their own broker; endpoints offered for download.

one_line_pitch: Uses existing hospital room cameras and pose detection to track patient movement and alert nurses to risky immobility that causes pressure ulcers.
problem_statement: Bedsores are common and preventable but rely on manual repositioning checks by hospital staff.
distinctive_notes: No extra sensors; MediaPipe and YOLO pose on RGB feeds for multiple patients; per-patient immobility thresholds in backend; Flask dashboard with GIF updates; cites mortality and cost statistics.
impact_claims_note: Cites 2.5 million patients per year, 9.1% vs 1.8% mortality, and $26.8 billion annual US cost of pressure injuries.

one_line_pitch: AI conversation tutor for language learners that gives instant grammar corrections and a language-independent pronunciation check.
problem_statement: Language apps lack natural conversation with native-like feedback, and waiting for corrections slows learning.
distinctive_notes: Started on Snap Spectacles with Lens Studio but pivoted to a Flask web app after text-to-speech bugs; uses zero-shot cross-lingual phoneme recognition paper for pronunciation.

one_line_pitch: Mobile app concept that classifies wound photos with a CNN, shows confidence scores, and helps patients track healing.
problem_statement: Patients managing wounds lack an easy way to monitor healing and get a quick classification of wound type.
distinctive_notes: Writeup is generic and partly inconsistent (How built mentions plant disease classification); one teammate notes an AI segmentation feature; stack listed as just Python and React.

one_line_pitch: Snap AR lens that scans a room, labels objects, and signals safe locations with audio and visual cues plus a voice-activated floating checklist.
problem_statement: Writeup gives no problem beyond wanting a useful Snap AR idea; implied need is guiding users to safe spots.
target_user: AR glasses users needing safety guidance
distinctive_notes: Built in Lens Studio for Snap AR with voice recognition asset; checklist can follow the user or stay fixed; very short writeup; no ML yet.

one_line_pitch: Discord bot that checks uploaded skin photos for melanoma with OpenCV image processing and lists the five nearest hospitals via Google Maps.
problem_statement: People worried about skin cancer often find out late and lack a quick way to screen and find care.
distinctive_notes: First-hackathon team; relies on pre-trained OpenCV models rather than training, reporting 82% labeling accuracy; Kaggle dataset; delivered entirely as a Discord bot in Python.
impact_claims_note: States about 200,000 melanoma diagnoses yearly and 82% cumulative labeling accuracy of its own bot.

one_line_pitch: Multimodal fatigue detector for doctors using face video and voice audio, with explainable saliency maps.
problem_statement: Fatigued doctors make diagnostic errors and burn out, yet few systems exist to detect and support them.
distinctive_notes: Fine-tuned vision transformer on a fatigue-face dataset plus HuBERT audio emotion model; inference ran on a remote RTX 4090 machine streamed over WebRTC.
sponsor_fit_note: Detects clinician fatigue to reduce misdiagnosis, fitting a health-focused challenge; PHRI sponsor products not stated.
impact_claims_note: Cites a malpractice payout and a physician suicide-rate statistic; reports ~92% model accuracy on unseen data.

one_line_pitch: Sensor-equipped smart pill bottle that streams pill-count data to a web dashboard showing adherence scores and anomalies.
problem_statement: Many chronic patients skip prescribed doses, costing the healthcare system heavily and muddying clinical trial data.
distinctive_notes: 3D-printed bottle with ESP32-C3 and load cell detecting pill weight changes; firmware posts to a backend that computes stats into Supabase.
impact_claims_note: Cites 30-50% non-adherence rate and $100-300B annual US cost.

one_line_pitch: Citation-network explorer for research papers with an AI assistant that can manipulate the graph, plus notes and exports.
problem_statement: Literature reviews are slow, requiring manual tracking of citations, trends and reference-manager entries.
distinctive_notes: Cedar OS floating assistant acts on the frontend (highlights nodes, adds papers) via a Mastra/GPT-4o backend; exports JSON, BibTeX, PNG and PDF review.

one_line_pitch: Meeting coach that aligns transcripts with audience emotion analysis and sends coaching feedback into Slack, Docs and Attio.
problem_statement: Presenters leave meetings unsure how their message landed and lack concrete feedback on delivery.
distinctive_notes: Electron app records meetings via Recall.ai; ResNet50+LSTM emotion model plus custom brow-furrow confusion metric merged by timestamp with AssemblyAI transcript; Mastra delivers output.

one_line_pitch: Chrome extension that scans pages for WCAG/ADA problems, highlights them in place, and uses OpenAI to suggest fixes.
problem_statement: Most websites fail accessibility guidelines because developers treat accessibility as an afterthought.
distinctive_notes: Seven-category rule-based scanner in vanilla JS with Motion.js animations, esbuild bundling for Manifest V3, and OpenAI explanations; scoring A/AA/AAA tiers.
impact_claims_note: Cites 216 million visually impaired people and a WebAIM finding that over 96% of top sites fail guidelines.

one_line_pitch: Onboarding assistant that ingests GitHub, Slack, docs and terminal commands, answering questions with cited sources and a reference timeline.
problem_statement: New engineers lose weeks piecing together context scattered across Slack, PRs, docs and CI history.
distinctive_notes: Hybrid dense (nomic-embed-text) and TF-IDF sparse retrieval in ChromaDB; polls GitHub and Slack every second for incremental re-indexing; timeline UI shows cited sources.

one_line_pitch: VR firefighter training in a burning maze where walking in place with a body-worn IMU tracker drives locomotion.
problem_statement: First responders need realistic, affordable VR training, but treadmills and forward-only movement limit realism.
distinctive_notes: Custom IMU chest tracker with microcontroller with PlatformIO firmware feeding a C++ SteamVR/OpenVR driver; fire spreads over time; three trackers built but only chest one used.

one_line_pitch: Web uploader with AI tagging that turns hackathon photos into spatially anchored mixed-reality museum exhibits on Quest 3.
problem_statement: Hackathon memories get lost as photos on phones rather than shared, explorable experiences.
distinctive_notes: Quest 3 app places exhibits via spatial anchors around the actual venue, with occlusion shaders; Cedar spells and natural-language filtering; self-hosted VPS with Coolify.

one_line_pitch: iPhone camera and LiDAR app that guides visually impaired users around obstacles and to objects using spatial audio in AirPods.
problem_statement: Visually impaired people lack affordable, accessible tools for navigating everyday surroundings independently.
distinctive_notes: Swift app streams MJPEG and LiDAR packets over WebSockets to a Python server running YOLO; hand-guidance mode uses hand tracking and pitch/tempo audio cues at over 20 fps.
impact_claims_note: Cites 7.3M visually impaired US adults, 1M fully blind, 70% unemployed; claims over 20 fps processing.

one_line_pitch: Privacy-first triage assistant: patient-held medical passport shared by short-lived QR code, with an LLM agent asking follow-ups and ranking patients.
problem_statement: Triage errors are common and stem from missing patient history and inefficient triage processes in emergency departments.
target_user: triage nurses, emergency providers and patients
distinctive_notes: Rotating 60-second session ID points to temporary S3 bucket (AES-GCM planned but dropped); LangGraph agents with user-interrupt; pivoted from NFC after a sponsor engineer conversation; GPT-5 used instead of local model.
impact_claims_note: Cites 150M annual US ED visits and a study finding about a third of triage decisions are erroneous.

one_line_pitch: Turns photos and documents into an interactive 3D knowledge graph of people, places and moments, searchable with hybrid RAG.
problem_statement: Personal memories spread across photos and documents are hard to explore and connect.
distinctive_notes: Writeup is a short repo-style tech summary; pairs Neo4j graph with pgvector via external R2R service for ingestion, NER and RAG; 3D force-graph front end.

one_line_pitch: Analyzes uploaded trade history for behavioral biases like revenge trading using heuristics, logistic regression, an LLM classifier and an AI coach.
problem_statement: Existing trading tools focus on markets, not on the psychological patterns that drive traders to lose money.
distinctive_notes: Solo build; three-layer behavior pipeline (rules, logistic regression, LLaMA sequence classifier) plus RAG coaching via Claude and OpenAI; demo video has no audio.

one_line_pitch: Bike add-on with handlebar turn-signal controller, rear LCD signal and brake display, camera feed, and phone app for speed and maps.
problem_statement: Cyclists on campus feel unsafe at intersections because hand signaling is awkward and unclear to others.
distinctive_notes: ESP32 rear box acts as Wi-Fi access point and web server streaming MJPEG to the app; brake detection fuses GPS, accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer; laser-cut acrylic housing.

one_line_pitch: Portable device that photographs an object, gets a Gemini description, and embosses a short Braille label with servo-driven pins.
problem_statement: Most everyday packaged goods have no Braille, leaving visually impaired people dependent on workarounds to identify items.
distinctive_notes: Six micro servos press Braille dots into paper while a DC motor advances it; Arduino UNO R4 receives text over serial from a laptop web app; 3D-printed housing.

one_line_pitch: Second-screen app for live NFL games with sponsor-funded community micro bets, private team leaderboards and an AI explainer chatbot.
problem_statement: Watching sports is passive, and beginners and communities lack engaging shared ways to follow games.
distinctive_notes: Custom WebSocket wrapper over Sportradar NFL feed simulates live events; GPT generates micro-bet prompts; sponsor-backed bets convert community accuracy into charity donations.
sponsor_fit_note: Built a second-screen live-sports experience with in-game micro bets, matching the PrizePicks second-screen prize theme.

one_line_pitch: Wearable leg exoskeleton that uses IMUs to detect gait phase and drives two brushless motors to assist walking, adjustable assist level.

impact_claims_note: States 25% of elderly have trouble with daily activities and up to 50% muscle loss by 80s; claims up to 40 lbs force assist.

sponsor_fit_note: Built a health-focused rehab system around Meta Quest and Muse Spark with a clinician EHR loop.

problem_statement: Clinicians seeing a Parkinson's patient in an emergency lack a record of normal motor function, making stroke assessment harder.
distinctive_notes: Stores derived tapping measurements instead of video; NFC tag gives licensed providers access; page states it gives context only and does not diagnose stroke.

one_line_pitch: Turns uploaded lecture material into a sea-creature study game with Pokemon-style AR duels, XP progression and a practice-exam boss.

distinctive_notes: Browser-only AR with device motion and on-device face detection mini-games; Gemini output validated server-side with retries and fallback models; MongoDB with local JSON fallback.

one_line_pitch: Desktop agent for Google Meet that detects AI-cloned voices, masks keystroke sounds against acoustic attacks, and redacts spoken secrets.
problem_statement: Voice-cloned callers and microphone-based keystroke eavesdropping can leak passwords and codes during video calls.
target_user: people on video calls handling sensitive information
distinctive_notes: Injects audio bridge into Chrome Meet session via DevTools; self-built keystroke attacker versus LLM-driven adversarial shield; reports organizer metrics minDCF 0.058, EER 2.5%; 90 mock-driver tests.
sponsor_fit_note: Trained fused XLS-R and gradient-boosted real-vs-synthetic voice detector on the NSA Hearsay challenge and reported organizer scores.

one_line_pitch: Reinforcement-learning agent plays Pokemon Crystal to the first gym badge, calling an LLM only for stuck or hard moments.
problem_statement: Calling an LLM on every game frame is slow and costly; most steps are mechanical and need no language reasoning.
distinctive_notes: 13.2M-parameter vision plus RAM GRU policy in PyBoy; Gemini tool calls only on triggers with logged reasons and dollar cost; reward shaped on story event flags; 34 test modules.

one_line_pitch: Semi-automatic disaster-relief drone system: Perceptron model finds people and distance, data lands in TigerData, and an optimizer picks the next drone move.
problem_statement: Disaster drone relief is manual, error-prone under stress and hard to standardize, giving poor emergency response.
distinctive_notes: Closed loop from drone telemetry to people-detection to 2D map to optimizer; claims about 8x faster median response than brute force on benchmarks; demo video sped up and author asks 0.75x viewing.
sponsor_fit_note: Used Perceptron's vision model to detect people and distance, and TigerData as the time-series store, in a disaster-response loop.
impact_claims_note: Says optimization is about 8x faster median response than brute force on benchmarks.

one_line_pitch: Turns fixed-camera video into per-flower insect visit records, forecasts insect paths and plans a pollinator robot route, with an RL bee simulation.
problem_statement: Pollinators are declining and crops depend on them; growers lack actionable data on which flowers get visited and how a robot could help.
distinctive_notes: Cheap OpenCV tracker confirmed by Perceptron Mk1.5 crops (visit precision 64% to 90%); cached API client replays offline; RL bee replayed in MuJoCo with Crazyflie model; 48 clips from public datasets.
sponsor_fit_note: Used Perceptron Mk1.5 for box detection, JSON-schema output and Files API to verify insects and locate flowers in video.
impact_claims_note: Cites a third of food depending on pollinators and reports accuracy figures such as 90% tracking coverage and 79% top-3 next-flower accuracy.

one_line_pitch: Python library and Claude Code plugin that records agent tool calls and turns expensive successful runs into verified single-call tools.
problem_statement: Agents rediscover the same long tool-call sequences every run, wasting tokens and time, and generated tools are hard to trust.
target_user: developers running AI agents in production
distinctive_notes: Published to PyPI (0.1.0) and installable as Claude Code plugin; proposals pass AST static, replay and efficiency checks with a draft-to-deprecated lifecycle; 338 offline tests.
impact_claims_note: Demo claim of a 20-30 call discovery run reduced to one distilled call with four inside; business-model reasoning without market numbers.

one_line_pitch: Webcam fighting game that scans you into a rigged 3D fighter and lets you box peer-to-peer using body-motion intent detection.
problem_statement: Motion boxing games lack the impact and feel of classic arcade fighters; the team wanted that effect from a camera.
distinctive_notes: Own GPU server runs TRELLIS.2 to make a 3D fighter from a scan in about 40 seconds with a custom Blender auto-rigger; Omegle-style WebRTC matchmaking; ElevenLabs live commentary.

one_line_pitch: VS Code extension that graphs a C/C++ codebase, explains nodes with AI, and scores the risk of changing each node.
problem_statement: With more AI-written code, developers lose understanding of large codebases that are hard to navigate, especially beginners.
distinctive_notes: Calls VS Code Language Model API (Copilot Chat or GPT-4o); Ask AI panel highlights and traces affected nodes; change-risk score per node; limited to C/C++ so far.

one_line_pitch: Browser extension that collects rewards from a dedicated inbox and uses a constraint solver to stack coupons, memberships and card cashback at checkout.
problem_statement: Shoppers collect loyalty rewards and coupons but forget or misuse them, losing savings.
target_user: online shoppers and merchants running loyalty programs
distinctive_notes: OR-Tools CP-SAT stacking with 200ms budget and greedy fallback; locally trained SetFit email classifier plus JSON-LD, regex and GLiNER extraction; encrypted reward codes; claims no outside service calls.
sponsor_fit_note: Framed around Visa's loyalty-rewards statistics and card-benefit stacking for the shopping track; no Visa API listed.
impact_claims_note: Cites Visa figures of 17.4 memberships held vs 8.8 used and up to $10 billion missed annually; labels benefits as potential, not measured.

one_line_pitch: Fabric wristband with four haptic motors that cues blind and low-vision users which direction to move their hand to reach an object.
problem_statement: Assistive tools focus on navigation, with few helping blind users locate and reach small objects such as items on a table.

sponsor_fit_note: Built an AI lost-and-found system with hardware lockers for the SAP challenge (brief not on page); SAP products are not mentioned.

impact_claims_note: Impact section is qualitative only, no numbers.
